descs.t: President Trump signed a proclamation making the Oval Office and the Cabinet Room national monuments under the Antiquities Act. AP reports that future presidents can still redecorate. We go through what the order covers and what it leaves open.

Trump made the Oval Office and Cabinet Room national monuments, with a red VETO hat on the Resolute Desk as he signed. The White House kept CNN out of the pool for the event. We look at what the order changes, and what the veto hat signals for the new Congress.

Days after the midterm results, Trump signed the Oval Office into a national monument with a VETO hat beside him. The order says the rooms cannot be torn down or altered at will, while reports say decor can still change. We break down the move and the veto fight it points to.
